targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp                    AS time,
  tank_1_fr_45_ps_level__value AS fresh_water_tank_1_level,
  tank_2_fr_45_sb_level__value AS fresh_water_tank_2_level
FROM public.marpower__250000_fresh_water
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'tank_1_fr_45_ps_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS fresh_water_tank_1_level_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'tank_2_fr_45_sb_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS fresh_water_tank_2_level_tag
FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-fresh-water'

SELECT
	timestamp                AS time,
	hotwater_11_level__value AS tank11_level,
	hotwater_13_level__value AS tank13_level,
	hotwater_15_level__value AS tank15_level
FROM marpower__340000_tankage_system
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'hotwater11_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS tank11_level_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'hotwater13_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS tank13_level_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'hotwater15_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS tank15_level_tag
FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/340000-tankage'
